description: PostToolUse on Bash: a shell command that touched a display or a production program (xdotool, wmctrl, import -window, Kdenlive's D-Bus, pactl, kdenlive, ardour, musescore) outside film_desk.py is written as an improvised act to the miadi-film acts log (MIADI_FILM_ACTS_LOG, default ~/.local/state/miadi-film/acts.jsonl). Silent and never blocks. Loads at session start.
